title: THE HOTEL · DUMBBELL LADDER · UPPER
vibe: GREEN · 45 MIN · LIFT DAY, LEGS SPARED
why: Four straight run days (13 miles, 10-31 to 11-03) and no lifting since Thursday. Today is the lift you missed: an upper-body dumbbell ladder on an 18-minute clock, legs touched only in the warm-up and one short sprint salt. Shape from the muscle-building manual (Week 3 Day 3: horizontal push + rows), movements half from today's dumbbell-only research, dressed as a ladder because the last two cards were a for-time run and a ruck.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · SHOULDERS + SPINE
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day A · ONE PASS · light 10 lb DB where named

items.name: Towel shoulder dislocates
items.detail: x10, wide grip, slow over and back

items.name: Thoracic rotations (quadruped)
items.detail: x8/side, follow the hand with your eyes

items.name: Jefferson curl, 10 lb DB
items.detail: x6, 3-count down, roll up one vertebra at a time

items.name: Hamstring walkouts
items.detail: x6, hands walk out to plank and back

items.name: Active pigeon
items.detail: 30 s/side, press the front shin into the floor

items.name: Wrist rocks
items.detail: x10 each direction, loads the floor press

blocks.title: THE LADDER · 18:00 CAP · 2-4-6-8-10
blocks.meta: ONE PASS · 5 RUNGS · 6 stations in order · reps per station = the rung · rest only when a set breaks
blocks.workRest: 18:00 cap · rungs 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 · unilateral stations are per side

items.name: 1 · Floor press, 2 x 50 lb
items.detail: Elbows 45°, 2-count pause on the floor, drive up together

items.name: 2 · Meadows row, 50 lb
items.detail: Staggered stance, elbow drives high and back, per side

items.name: 3 · Seated halo press, 35 lb
items.detail: Sit on the bench edge, halo around the head then press overhead (one rep = halo + press)

items.name: 4 · Bent-over reverse fly, 2 x 15 lb
items.detail: Hinge flat, thumbs up, 1-count squeeze at the top

items.name: 5 · Zottman curl, 2 x 25 lb
items.detail: WILDCARD · curl palms up, rotate at the top, lower palms down on a 3-count

items.name: 6 · Alternating lateral lunge, 35 lb at the chest
items.detail: Per side, only leg work in the block, keep it smooth not fast

blocks.text: Rung 2 is a warm-up rung, move. Rungs 8 and 10 are where it is earned. GREEN: finished rung 10 under 16:00, add a rung of 12 until the clock. YELLOW: stop at rung 8. If a press rep fails, drop 50s to 45s on the floor press and keep moving.

blocks.title: SPRINT SALT · 6 × 30 S
blocks.meta: 6 ROUNDS · 30 s @ 9.0 mph / 30 s walk @ 3.0 · 2% incline

items.name: Sprint, 9.0 mph, 2% incline
items.detail: 30 s, cadence quick (168+), hands off the rails

blocks.text: Deliberately tiny after four run days. This is the only run leg today. Do not stretch it into a mile.

blocks.title: MIDLINE CLOSE · 2 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 2 ROUNDS · straight through · rest 45 s between rounds

items.name: Side plank reach-under, 15 lb DB
items.detail: x8/side, top arm threads under and back to the ceiling (manual: side plank)

items.name: Plank rotational press, 20 lb DB
items.detail: x5/side, from push-up plank row the bell then press it to the ceiling as you rotate (manual: plank rotational press)

items.name: Dead bug with DB press-out, 2 x 10 lb
items.detail: x10/side, bells pressed to the ceiling, opposite heel taps the floor

items.name: Suitcase carry, 50 lb
items.detail: 40 steps/side down the hallway or across the gym, ribs down, do not lean

blocks.title: COOLDOWN · 3 MIN
blocks.meta: walk 3.0 mph on the belt, then doorway pec stretch 30 s/side
blocks.text: Record ladder time (or rungs done at the cap), top rung reached, sprint speed held, and RPE.
